title: dublin.json board bytes are not bound by any golden header anchor (catalog_hash folds only the 7 catalog sources)
evidence:
core/catalog.odin:1487 `catalogs_hash_sources :: proc(src: ^Catalog_Sources) -> u64 {` folds exactly: `fold(&h, src.node_types)`, `fold(&h, src.pipe_tiers)`, `fold(&h, src.packet_types)`, `fold(&h, src.demand)`, `fold(&h, src.eras)`, `fold(&h, src.crises)`, `fold(&h, src.balance)` — no dublin.json. harness/catalogs.odin reads dublin.json only in board_load: `bytes, e := os.read_entire_file_from_path("data/maps/dublin.json", context.temp_allocator)`. harness/manifest.odin:93 writes only: `fmt.sbprintf(&sb, "t1 1
demo %s
seed %d
logic_hz %d
catalog_hash %016x
ticks %d
",`. Verified at HEAD: goldens/dublin_board.t1 carries catalog_hash e4a7a49e09d2c0e7 and no board hash.
detail: A dublin.json edit fails dublin goldens at tick-hash mismatch while the header claims catalogs unchanged — the 'defined re-bless' discipline (manifest.odin: 'header carries catalog_hash + logic_hz so retuning either is a DEFINED re-bless') has a third unbound run-setup input. Caught loudly, but not localized.
recommended_fix: Fold dublin.json bytes into the dublin demos' anchor: either add a board_hash manifest line (FNV over the asset bytes, replay-gated) or extend catalogs_hash_sources with the map source.

title: 5th hand-rolled Demo_Replay population: dublin-grown verb copy-pastes load_demo_replay's field-copy block
evidence: harness/dublin_shot.odin:147-163: `cfg := Demo_Replay{ name = demo.name, use_fixture = demo.use_fixture, qos_fixture = demo.qos_fixture, growth_on = demo.growth_on, advance_gate_on = demo.advance_gate_on, map_source = demo.map_source, session = {goal = demo.win_goal, cap_ms = demo.lose_cap_ms, health_on = demo.health_on, surge_win_pct = demo.surge_win_pct}, }` followed by `for n in demo.nodes { append(&cfg.nodes, n) }` — a near-verbatim copy of load_demo_replay (run.odin:764 `cfg := Demo_Replay{name = demo_name, use_fixture = true}` ... run.odin:776 `for n in demo.nodes {`). This PR added it (044a6d2^:harness/dublin_shot.odin contains zero 'Demo_Replay' occurrences), making 5 sites: run.odin:321, run.odin:764, dublin_shot.odin:147, motion_strip.odin:72, overlay.odin:174 — against the struct's own contract (run.odin:685-687): 'ONE struct threaded through BOTH the live run (run_demo) and every replay path (replay_hashes) so a new run-setup piece can never drift out of sync'.
detail: Every new Demo_Replay run-setup field must now be hand-threaded at five sites; the dublin-grown copy already diverges subtly (use_fixture taken directly vs defaulted). This is exactly the drift the struct's doc comment warns about.
recommended_fix: Extract demo_replay_from_demo(demo: ^Demo, cfg: ^Demo_Replay) holding the shared field-copy + array-append block; call it from load_demo_replay and run_dublin_grown.

title: district live-count re-derived as O(districts × nodes) per call, invoked per district / per cluster / per drawn tile (r1 note, still unfixed at 04ef6a9)
evidence: growth_district_live_count (growth.odin:532) scans every node and per node runs the O(districts) nearest-anchor scan: `for i in 0..<len(t.node_alive) { if !t.node_alive[i] || t.node_kind[i] != .Terminal { continue } if map_district_assign(board, t.node_pos[i]) == d { n += 1 } }`. Call sites, each re-deriving from scratch: growth.odin:566 (per district in growth_board_seed_draw's eligibility loop): `if growth_district_live_count(board, t, u16(d)) >= growth_district_cap(board, cat, u16(d)) {`; growth.odin:851 (per eligible cluster per ATTACH attempt): `if growth_district_live_count(board, t, d) >= growth_district_cap(board, cat, d) {`; growth.odin:966 (per drawn tile — and map_district_assign called twice more on the same line): `if growth_district_live_count(board, t, map_district_assign(board, pos)) >= growth_district_cap(board, cat, map_district_assign(board, pos)) {`.
detail: Worst case ~O(districts² × nodes × attempts) per seed window. Negligible at dublin scale (52 districts, ~60 nodes) and the pure-function shape avoids cache invalidation on demolish — acceptable now, but quadratic growth path.
recommended_fix: Derive per-district live counts once per spawn window into a scratch array (nodes-to-districts single pass) and read from it at the three call sites.
